visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a maroon off-the-shoulder top and blue jeans, holds a large white box featuring Zootopia characters in a studio setting with bright indoor lighting. (2) She turns the box to show the back, pointing to various character icons printed on the packaging while smiling. (3) The setting shifts to a retail-like counter or office desk where she opens the outer box to reveal 12 smaller blind boxes arranged in rows. (4) The woman interacts with a large group of people in an office environment; they stand around her as she distributes the blind boxes. (5) A series of fast-paced cuts shows individual members of the group opening their boxes, displaying shocked and joyful facial expressions while holding up miniature figurines. (6) The final scene shows the entire group of about ten people huddled together, holding their various figurines and waving toward the camera in a celebratory manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-pitched, energetic female narration introducing the unboxing, set against a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat. (2) A sharp paper rustling sound triggers as the main box is handled, followed by several layers of female and male voices engaged in playful banter. (3) Multiple high-energy screams and bursts of laughter occur as individuals reveal their blind box contents, creating a dense acoustic environment of cheers and applauses. (4) Frequent comic sound effects such as 'dings' and 'pop' sounds are synchronized with the figurine reveals, momentarily competing with the music volume. (5) The conversation remains rapid-fire and high-arousal throughout the group session, with distinct paper rustling and thudding sounds of plastic figurines hitting the desk. (6) The audio track concludes with a loud, synchronized group shout of 'Merry Christmas' followed by a final swell of cheering and collective clapping.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Sequential Unboxing Reactions -> Group Celebration
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide high-energy entertainment through a group unboxing of POP MART Zootopia blind boxes, celebrating a festive atmosphere and showcasing the collectible figures to an audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging and enthusiastic unboxing of branded POP MART merchandise.
